description:
Install any app on Samsung Tizen devices — TVs, projectors and smart monitors

Cross-platform desktop installer that side-loads any app onto Samsung Smart TVs, projectors and smart monitors running Tizen OS — Jellyfin, Moonlight, Moonfin, Litefin and a community catalog, or your own WGT package. Handles device discovery, Tizen certificates and installation. Successor to Jellyfin2Samsung.Jellyfin2Samsung.
📦 v2.7.4 — 2026-08-14
✨ New
- App icons & titles — one shared editor on desktop and mobile. The icon changer now lives in Core, so both heads present the same manifest-driven app list. You can give any app a custom launcher title (written into the package's config.xml <name> at install) right alongside a custom icon. On mobile this replaces the old free-form "type an app name and pick a PNG" rows with the same app list the desktop shows. (#521)
🐛 Fixes
- "TV Name could not be found" no longer trips on a momentary hiccup. SDB now retries idempotent read commands when the transport resets mid-command, so a transient blip during device discovery doesn't fail the whole connection. (#524 / #525)
- Manually-entered TV IPs are no longer wrongly rejected as "Invalid device IP". Manual entry now accepts a TV on the SDB debug port alone — the same bar the network scan uses — instead of also demanding the 8001 REST API be open. A TV the scan would find is no longer rejected when typed in by hand. (#523)
- Package picker defaults to WGT/TPK. The manual "Select package" dialog now shows both .wgt and .tpk by default instead of hiding .tpk behind a filter switch.
📱 Android distribution
- The Android app is now installable via Obtainium, which auto-updates from these GitHub stable releases. An IzzyOnDroid (F-Droid) inclusion request is in review.
